findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 4 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Biology Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 167 questions numbered 1-167; by section: 4.1 10, 4.2 8, 4.3 5, 4.4 27, 4.5 35, 4.6 34, 4.7 23, 4.8 20, 4.9 5. Keys: {'a': 42, 'b': 42, 'c': 41, 'd': 42}.

Covers every section 4.1-4.9 in order: biochemistry and the biological molecules, bonds, condensation and hydrolysis, the properties of water, carbohydrates (mono-, di- and polysaccharides, rings, isomers), proteins (amino acids, peptide bond, classification, roles, structural levels), lipids, nucleic acids (DNA, RNA, central dogma) and conjugated molecules. None repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed: sucrose is C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁, amylose (not amylase) and amylopectin are broken by amylase, Berzelius named protein in 1838, in ester formation OH leaves the acid and H the alcohol. Not used: the oxytocin and cellulase statements and the empirical formula C(H₂O)ₙ (see report).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
